niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel light, open, and highly legible, with clear structure, explicit labels, and obvious next steps. They consistently favor strong information hierarchy, readable text on lighter surfaces, balanced spacing, polished grouped cards/sections, and UI that makes actions discoverable through labeled buttons rather than hidden or icon-only controls. They also tend to like screens that feel complete and purposeful, with enough visible information to support decisions without looking cluttered.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers clear sectioning, strong grouping, obvious reading order, and layouts where the primary content and actions are easy to scan immediately.
Prefers high text legibility with strong contrast, clearer labels, and content that is easy to parse at a glance.
Prefers open spacing, balanced padding, and layouts with breathing room rather than tightly packed compositions.
Prefers explicit, labeled, easy-to-find actions and CTAs, with visible options rather than icon-only or hidden actions.
Prefers refined, finished-looking interfaces with consistent styling, balanced controls, and cohesive visual treatment.
Prefers screens that feel fully built out and purposeful, avoiding sparse, unfinished, or awkwardly empty layouts.
Prefers content organized into clearly separated cards, rows, or sections that strengthen grouping and scanability.
